name: Rain Radar
description: The rain radar around the panel as a printed map: a label-free coast, water and roads with the latest echoes stippled over it in three intensities, a range ring and a home mark, the last hour as a strip of small frames, and a plain-words headline such as Rain in about 20 min or Dry for the next hour. Radar from RainViewer, base map from Esri, no key needed.

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Place
cell_options.help: Home, at the centre of the map. Falls back to the app-level location in Settings when empty.

cell_options.name: range
cell_options.label: Within
cell_options.help: How much country the short side of the cell shows. The ring is drawn at a tenth, a quarter or a half of it.

cell_options.name: layout
cell_options.label: Layout
cell_options.help: Map and strip puts the last hour under the map with the headline set along the edge. Map and headline gives the headline the room, with a legend of the three intensities.

cell_options.name: frames
cell_options.label: How many frames
cell_options.help: Past frames in the strip, ten minutes apart. More frames means more tile requests on the first render.

cell_options.name: colour
cell_options.label: Rain colour
cell_options.help: Teal stipple for colour panels. Ink draws the rain in black for a black and white panel.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: The words before the time. Leave empty to show the place instead.
